events = {row[0]: {'name': row[1], 'type': row[2]} for row in cur.fetchall()}
conn.close()

print(f'Events with >10 attendees: {len(over_10)}')
for eid, count, evt_type in sorted(over_10, key=lambda x: -x[1]):

print(f'Meeting events with >10 attendees: {meeting_count}')
